title: Prepare the annual report for a small bookshop with a loss and a shareholder contribution
person: The owner of a small bookshop by the harbour in Ystad who wants the annual report in English for a co-owner who reads no Swedish.

occupation.name: First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers

review: Hamnbodens Bokhandel AB, 556000-0003, calendar year 2025 under K2, in English: net sales SEK 968,000, a loss of SEK 114,200 (2024: loss of SEK 3,400); the SEK 120,000 shareholder contribution shown in the changes in equity under retained earnings; total assets SEK 246,400 (2024: 259,800); SEK 41,300 carried forward and no dividend; floating charges of SEK 150,000 as pledged assets; signed in Ystad on 15 April 2026 by Elin Persson and Tomas Ek.
revised_review: The unbooked SEK 14,000 supplier invoice is added: other external expenses SEK 301,000, a loss of SEK 128,200, trade payables SEK 47,800, equity SEK 52,300 and SEK 27,300 carried forward; total assets stay SEK 246,400.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Management report (business, events, multi-year overview, changes in equity, disposition), income statement, balance sheet, notes and signatures, in that order, with the name and organisation number.
Amounts in whole kronor, the unit stated once and kept.
Last year's figures beside this year's on every line, taken from last year's report.
Every subtotal and result line adds up, both years.
Total assets SEK 246,400 equal equity and liabilities (2024: 259,800), before and after the revision.
The year's result is the same in every place it appears.
The changes in equity run from last year's balance sheet to this year's.
SEK 41,300 at the meeting's disposal, all carried forward (revision: SEK 27,300).
Accounting policies, average number of employees and the fixed-asset note, numbered in order, the carrying amount matching the balance sheet.
Both board members sign under a place and date after the year end.
The shareholder contribution is a row of its own in the changes in equity, not income in the income statement.
A note gives the floating charges of SEK 150,000 as pledged assets for both years.
The management report says plainly that the year made a loss and why, without calling the company sound or the accounts approved.
The revised report carries the SEK 14,000 invoice through the result, the balance sheet, the changes in equity and the disposition.
